skills.name: Quickdraw
skills.humanReadableMechanics: Your first attack each turn costs 1 fewer action.

skills.name: Weapon Familiarity
skills.flavor: Hand and weapon move as one.
skills.humanReadableMechanics: +1 Fortune when attacking with your chosen weapon type.

skills.name: Battlefield Shift
skills.humanReadableMechanics: After an attack, spend 1 action to move 2 extra squares.

skills.name: Defensive Bind
skills.humanReadableMechanics: Spend 1 action to prepare a Parry before your next turn.

skills.name: Pressing Advance
skills.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, step into the target’s space and push them back 1 square.

skills.name: Weapon Master’s Eye
skills.humanReadableMechanics: Once per encounter, reroll a missed attack.

skills.name: Cleaving Strike
skills.humanReadableMechanics: Add slashing damage. If target’s Risk ≥ 20, also apply Bleed (1).

skills.name: Crushing Blow
skills.humanReadableMechanics: Add crushing damage and permanently reduce the target’s Guard by 2.

skills.name: Armour Splitter
skills.humanReadableMechanics: Add piercing damage; this attack has penetration 3.

skills.name: Disarm Twist
skills.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, make an opposed Strength check; on success, disarm the target.
